You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From ecf81ed98c8df8c6d397f4e044af175481b5b831 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Andrzej Hajda <a.hajda@samsung.com>
Date: Tue, 8 May 2018 11:36:58 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/exynos/dsi: mask frame-done interrupt

DSI driver is not really interested in this interrupt. It causes only
unnecessary code execution of interrupt handler and could possibly
cause FIFO overflow - as it triggers DSI interrupt handler to process
next DSI transfer. With this patch we will get rid of about 30 IRQ
handler calls per second.

Fixes: e6f988a45857 ("drm/exynos: dsi: add support for Exynos5433")
Signed-off-by: Andrzej Hajda <a.hajda@samsung.com>
Signed-off-by: Inki Dae <inki.dae@samsung.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/exynos/exynos_drm_dsi.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/exynos/exynos_drm_dsi.c
index eae44fd714f0..7c3030b7e586 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/exynos/exynos_drm_dsi.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/exynos/exynos_drm_dsi.c
@@ -1264,15 +1264,15 @@ static irqreturn_t exynos_dsi_irq(int irq, void *dev_id)
 
 	if (status & DSIM_INT_SW_RST_RELEASE) {
 		u32 mask = ~(DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
-			DSIM_INT_SFR_HDR_FIFO_EMPTY | DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE |
-			DSIM_INT_RX_ECC_ERR | DSIM_INT_SW_RST_RELEASE);
+			DSIM_INT_SFR_HDR_FIFO_EMPTY | DSIM_INT_RX_ECC_ERR |
+			DSIM_INT_SW_RST_RELEASE);
 		exynos_dsi_write(dsi, DSIM_INTMSK_REG, mask);
 		complete(&dsi->completed);
 		return IRQ_HANDLED;
 	}
 
 	if (!(status & (DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
-			DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE | DSIM_INT_PLL_STABLE)))
+			DSIM_INT_PLL_STABLE)))
 		return IRQ_HANDLED;
 
 	if (exynos_dsi_transfer_finish(dsi))
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos/exynos_drm_dsi.c`**
- The interrupt mask for the DSI driver has been modified to exclude the `DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE` interrupt. 
- The line that previously included `DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE` in the mask has been removed, which means that this interrupt will no longer trigger the interrupt handler.

### Relationships
- The change is aimed at improving the efficiency of the DSI driver by preventing unnecessary calls to the interrupt handler caused by the `DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE` interrupt. This modification is expected to reduce the number of IRQ handler calls significantly (about 30 calls per second), thereby minimizing the risk of FIFO overflow and unnecessary code execution. The patch addresses a specific issue identified in a previous commit (e6f988a45857) that added support for Exynos5433, indicating that the change is a corrective measure to enhance the driver’s performance.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
mask = ~(DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
			DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE |
			DSIM_INT_RX_ECC_ERR | DSIM_INT_SW_RST_RELEASE);
```
```c
if (!(status & (DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
			DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE | DSIM_INT_PLL_STABLE)))
```
Reason:
The DSI driver was processing the `DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE` interrupt, which was unnecessary and led to excessive calls to the interrupt handler. This frequent triggering could cause FIFO overflow as the handler was invoked for each frame done event, leading to inefficient handling of DSI transfers.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
mask = ~(DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
			DSIM_INT_SFR_HDR_FIFO_EMPTY | 
			DSIM_INT_RX_ECC_ERR | DSIM_INT_SW_RST_RELEASE);
```
```c
if (!(status & (DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
			DSIM_INT_PLL_STABLE)))
```
Reason:
By removing `DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE` from the interrupt mask and the status check, the driver no longer processes this interrupt, thereby reducing unnecessary calls to the interrupt handler. This change helps prevent potential FIFO overflow and improves the efficiency of DSI transfer handling.
